situation.name: Coastal Storm & Flood — DEMO
situation.summary: Severe Atlantic cold front: 90 km/h gusts, 4-5 m swells and heavy rain flooding low-lying areas (Woodstock, Salt River). Storm surge threatening the Sea Point promenade. Two informal settlements evacuating.
situation.objectives:
1. Life safety — evacuate flood-risk zones
2. Open and staff shelters
3. Restore power & clear priority routes
4. Protect critical infrastructure (WWTW, substations)
